name: Periodic access certification
description: Access to systems handling cardholder data is re-certified by the owning manager on a fixed cycle; uncertified access is revoked.

name: Adverse action notice completeness
description: Every declined application generates a compliant adverse action notice with the principal reasons, within the required period.

name: Application completeness and disclosure
description: Applications are complete and required disclosures delivered before decisioning; incomplete files route to cure with notice-of-incompleteness timing honored.

name: Authorization availability and stand-in
description: Authorization availability is monitored against the network SLA with tested stand-in arrangements; incidents invoke the resilience playbook.

name: Cardholder authentication to policy
description: Cardholder authentication meets the risk-tiered policy before disclosure or account change, across every servicing channel.

name: Bureau furnishing accuracy
description: Furnished tradeline data is reconciled to the system of record before transmission; consumer disputes update furnishing.

name: Charge-off timing to policy
description: Charge-off executes at the policy timing aligned to regulatory guidance, with exceptions approved and documented.

name: Production change approval
description: No change reaches production without an approved change record, test evidence, and a rollback plan; emergency changes are reviewed after the fact.

name: Client reporting and feed monitoring
description: Contracted client reporting and data feeds are monitored to schedule and specification; misses alert before the client notices and count against the SLA.

name: Close reconciliation sign-off
description: Period-end reconciliations and journal approvals complete with segregation of duties before financial sign-off.

name: Complaint regulatory routing
description: Complaints are classified to taxonomy, resolved to SLA, and routed to regulators where required; executive and regulator complaints carry expedited handling.

name: Collections contact limits
description: Outbound contact respects time-of-day, frequency, and channel-consent constraints; blocked numbers and cease requests are honored.

name: Conversion balance and record verification
description: Portfolio conversions verify record counts, balances, and regulatory continuity before and after cutover, with client sign-off at each gate.

name: Cycle assessment validation
description: Interest, fee, and minimum-payment computation is validated against the cardholder agreement on every pricing or product change, and sampled each cycle.

name: Daily settlement and clearing reconciliation
description: Network settlement, clearing files, and interchange postings reconcile to network totals daily; unreconciled variances stop downstream posting.

name: Ingestion data quality gate
description: Source ingestion enforces schema and quality thresholds at the boundary; failing loads quarantine rather than land.

name: Recovery test against committed objectives
description: Recovery is exercised at least annually against stated RTO/RPO; misses produce tracked remediation.

name: Statutory collections notices
description: Validation and other statutory notices issue within the prescribed period with content owned by legal; continued collection is blocked until issued.

name: Fraud alert handling service level
description: Fraud alerts are actioned within the loss-budget SLA with disposition quality sampling; Reg E liability decisions are documented per case.

name: Settlement funding confirmation
description: The daily funding position is confirmed funded by the network deadline with dual verification and same-day escalation on a miss.

name: Security incident response execution
description: Security events run the incident response playbook with severity-driven escalation and post-incident review; the timeline is evidence.

name: Masked data outside production
description: Non-production environments carry masked or synthetic data; unmasked extracts require a time-boxed exception.

name: Furnishing and bucketing reconciliation
description: Delinquency bucketing and bureau furnishing reconcile to the system of record each cycle; unexplained movement blocks the file.

name: Marketing material compliance review
description: No creative or offer reaches market without documented compliance sign-off.

name: Notice content and delivery evidence
description: Required notices use legal-owned templates with version control, and delivery evidence is retained per notice.

name: Cardholder data scope and evidence maintenance
description: CDE scope, segmentation, and assessment evidence are maintained continuously against the PCI DSS requirement set.

name: Payment posting timeliness
description: Cardholder payments post as of the day of receipt per Reg Z crediting rules, with cutoff disclosures honored and exceptions reported.

name: Consumer privacy request fulfillment
description: Access and deletion requests are verified, fulfilled, and evidenced within the applicable statutory window.

name: Regulatory change implementation tracking
description: Applicability decisions and implementation actions for regulatory changes are tracked to evidenced completion with compliance sign-off.

name: Dispute acknowledgment timeliness
description: Written acknowledgment of an error claim is issued within the regulatory window; the timer starts at claim receipt, not triage.

name: Dispute determination timeliness and notice
description: Final dispute determinations, account adjustment, and the written explanation complete within the Reg E / Reg Z window; the clock is measured from claim receipt.

name: Provisional credit within regulatory window
description: Provisional credit is applied within the Reg E window when investigation extends past it, and collection on the disputed amount is suspended.

name: Regulatory report certification
description: Regulatory submissions reconcile to the ledger and prior filings and carry a named officer certification before transmission.

name: Retention schedule enforcement
description: Records are retained to schedule and destroyed on expiry with a certificate of disposition.

name: Sanctions and watchlist screening
description: Parties are screened at onboarding and on list updates; hits are dispositioned before processing continues.

name: Suspicious activity investigation and filing
description: Alerts are investigated and SARs filed within the statutory window, with supporting documentation retained.

name: Servicemember protections screening
description: SCRA and MLA eligibility is screened at origination and on notification, with rate and protection application evidenced.

name: Third-party due diligence before onboarding
description: No supplier processes cardholder data before risk-tiered due diligence is complete and accepted.

name: Treatment strategy approval
description: Collections treatment strategies and authorization strategies deploy only with documented risk and compliance approval and champion-challenger evidence.

name: Vulnerability remediation service level
description: Vulnerabilities are remediated within the SLA for their severity; breaches of the SLA are escalated and tracked.
